items.title: 3.2 Electronegativity aur bond ki qism (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 3.2, printed page 50.

blocks.text: Electronegativity chapter 1 mein bayan ho chuki; yahan bonding ki qism par us ka asar dekha jata hai. Do bandhe hue atoms ki electronegativity ka farq bond ki polarity ka taqreebi paimana aur bond ki qism ka ishara deta hai. Jab farq bohat chhota ya sifar ho to bond covalent aur non-polar hai; jab bara ho to bond polar covalent ya ionic. 0.4 se kam electronegativity farq wale do atoms khalis covalent bond banate hain; 0.4 aur 1.8 ke darmiyan farq polar covalent bond ke mutabiq hai; is se oopar bond ionic nau'iyat ka hai. H-H, H-Cl aur NaCl ke farq 0 (non-polar), 0.9 (polar covalent) aur 2.1 (ionic) hain, isi liye H-H khalis non-polar hai, H-Cl polar covalent bond aur NaCl ionic compound.

blocks.caption: Electronegativity farq se bond ki qism (Figure 3.4)

blocks.alt: 0 se 1.8 se oopar tak ek ufqi paimana neele se surkh tak shaded aur pure covalent, polar covalent aur ionic nishan-zada, jis par H-H, H-Cl aur NaCl rakhe hain. Neeche: HF molecule jis ka electron badal fluorine ki taraf khiska hai aur H se F tak teer, mure hue H2O aur SO2 molecules kul teeron ke saath, aur seedha BeCl2 aur tikona BF3 mukhalif teeron ke saath jo cancel hote hain.
blocks.caption: Electronegativity farq, bond ki qism aur dipole moments (Figures 3.4 se 3.7 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: 0.4 se kam farq khalis covalent bond deta hai, 0.4 se 1.8 polar covalent aur 1.8 se oopar ionic. HF mein baante hue electrons fluorine ke qareeb hain, to hydrogen delta+ aur fluorine delta- hai, aur dipole moment H se F ki taraf hai. H2O (1.85 D) aur SO2 (1.61 D) jaise mure molecules mein bond moments mil kar kul moment dete hain; mutawazan (symmetrical) BeCl2, BF3, CH4 aur CCl4 mein ba-qaida geometry mein barabar bond moments sifar tak cancel ho jate hain.

blocks.prompt: Electronegativity farq se andaza lagayein ke HF, KI, CaF2, ICl aur Br2 ke bonds non-polar covalent, polar covalent ya ionic hain.
blocks.explanation: Br2 ka farq sifar hai, to non-polar covalent. ICl ka farq chhota hai, qeematon ke mutabiq 0.4 se kam se taqreeban 0.5 tak, to khalis se halka polar covalent. HF ka farq taqreeban 1.9 hai aur woh shadeed polar covalent hai (ionic sarhad ke qareeb). KI (taqreeban 1.7) sarhad par hai aur amalan ionic gina jata hai; CaF2 (taqreeban 3.0) saaf ionic hai.

items: Electronegativity farq bond polarity napta hai: 0.4 se kam khalis covalent (H-H, 0), 0.4 se 1.8 polar covalent (H-Cl, 0.9), 1.8 se oopar ionic (NaCl, 2.1).
